name: Quest Diagnostics
import_label: Choose Apple Health ZIP or Quest PDFs…
manual_export_steps: Preferred for structured history: on iPhone, open Health, tap your profile picture, choose Health Records, add Quest Diagnostics, and sign in with MyQuest. After the records finish downloading, use Health → profile → Export All Health Data and import that ZIP here.
For individual reports: sign in to MyQuest, open Test Results, use the action next to a result, and choose Download PDF. Repeat for the reports you want, then select those PDFs here.
If older Quest results are missing, use Find my historical Quest results in MyQuest before exporting. Quest says electronic history may extend back to January 1, 2010.
registration_note: Quest supports Apple Health Records and publishes a FHIR API request form, but it does not publish the endpoint and public-client registration details Clippi-Health needs for a verified local OAuth profile. Direct connection remains disabled until Quest supplies and permits those details.
direct_note: Quest has a patient-facing FHIR path through Apple Health, but Clippi-Health still needs Quest's endpoint and third-party public-client registration. Use Apple Health or PDF import now.
